answer: One state-issued commercial diver certificate backs exactly one identity, registry-checked. Earning it takes an accredited school, 90 days of training and supervised dives from a cedar tender, a medical, an exam and a copper-helmeted qualification dive; a second claim on it is refused. Each fake costs 1,500 units and 90 days, so 100 fakes cost 150,000 units and 9,000 diver-days. The cheapest cheat is hiring a certified diver to lend their certificate for one voyage: the lender surrenders the certificate backing their own identity and faces revocation; a forgery fails the registry check.
